title: Normalized proper Brown scalar transport square
statement: For the proper strict-etale Brown data, a chosen projection isomorphism p whose inverse is the normalized mate satisfies the displayed scalar transport equality at every derived object P. This is the local realization square in the target theorem, with p and its mate equation supplied as hypotheses.

source.place: Construction 4.1, Constructions 5.14–5.15 and Lemma 5.16; Stacks 03CY, 06YY, 07A4 and 0GL6. The corresponding local step of lem-pur-etale-brown-level-comparisons.

proof.text: Use the normalized cochain representative equations, the derived mate comparison, and mate-pasting to identify the two composites in the displayed square.
